Es muy caro. 2200 un sanguche mas finito que mi celular no come ni uno de ahi. Tres fetas de matambre por 5500 pesos. Mas adelante en la ruta hay unos paradores buenísimo en los que por esa plata te dan hasta la bebida y el postre. Mejoren eso

It's way too expensive. 2200 pesos for a sandwich thinner than my cell phone—not even one of them could eat that much. Three slices of flank steak for 5500 pesos. Further down the road there are some great roadside restaurants where for that price they even give you a drink and dessert. They need to improve that.
